synthesis.paragraph: In today's research, "A Predictive–Prescriptive Analytics Framework for Route Planning" shares 5 references with the June 17 paper "TrafficMind," including "KST-GCN," "Critical Roles of Control Engineering," and "Harnessing multimodal large language models." Additionally, "Impact of Perceived Accident Risk on Automated Driving Technology Acceptance" shares 5 references with the July 3 paper "Integrating technology and sustainability" and 4 references with the July 10 paper "How can drivers be nudged to avoid distracted driving?". Author Yuehua Chen contributed to 2 papers in today's issue. Over the last 30 days, Hong Kong Polytechnic University appeared on 26 papers, Tongji University on 24, University of Hong Kong on 21, and Tsinghua University on 20.
